scripts.start: turbo run build -F web && node scripts/build.mjs && electron .
scripts.dev:hmr: concurrently -k -n web,app -c cyan,magenta "turbo run dev -F web" "node scripts/dev.mjs"
scripts.build: turbo run build -F web && node scripts/package.mjs --dir
scripts.build:stable: turbo run build -F web && node scripts/package.mjs --channel stable
scripts.build:canary: turbo run build -F web && node scripts/package.mjs --channel canary
